payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure that paths were not shared between training and test sets, including the elimination of queries observed during path training and the exclusion of hyponyms from the test and validation sets that appeared in the training set.

claims.text: All evaluated queries are new to both path-based and non-path models by eliminating queries observed during path training.
Hyponyms that appear in the training set are excluded from the test and validation sets to prevent models from copying.
None of the queries (synsets) are shared between the training and evaluation sets, ensuring distinct datasets.
